name: Dookki Sydney - 두끼 떡볶이 - Korean Tteokbokki Hotpot Buffet (All You Can Eat!)
reviews:
Tteokbokki is my all-time favorite comfort food, and this is definitely my favorite tteokbokki buffet! There are so many different types of rice cakes, and I love being able to make my own sauce exactly how I like it.
The fried chicken and other fried foods have gotten even better recently, and the upgraded dessert section is amazing. I especially loved the popsicles and Korean snacks—it really felt like I was back in Korea!
The restaurant is clean, the staff are friendly, and the food is always delicious. Highly recommend for anyone craving Korean food!

Didn’t expect this level of Korean tteokbokki all you can eat option in Sydney. The rice cakes were perfectly chewy and the DIY sauce bar was the highlight — you can really make it exactly to your taste. Ingredients were fresh, the place was clean, and the staff were friendly and efficient. Great spot when you’re craving authentic Korean street food. Definitely coming back.

Such a nice experience had a great dinner and enjoyed all you can eat tteobokki here. They also have wide variety like hot dishes, fishcake, kimbap, fried dishes, instant noodles, and more. Highly recommend! ⭐️

Such a fun and family-friendly dining experience at Dookki! The kids absolutely loved it — being able to create our own tteokbokki soup base made the whole meal interactive and exciting. There were so many ingredients to choose from, and it was great customizing the flavours just the way we like!

Had a really pleasant experience at Dookki Sydney! The food was great with a good selection of meats, noodles, and vegetables. They also have a wide range of soup bases with helpful recommendations. The staff were very attentive and friendly, and the whole cooking process was simple and straightforward with clear instructions. You get all the ingredients you need, and it’s fun to cook your own meal. Overall, a great experience. Would definitely come back!
